backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the e-commerce backend with product management, shopping cart operations, order placement, and admin authentication. Includes data types for Product, Order, and Cart, plus query/update functions for CRUD operations on products, cart management, and order history.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three features related to investigating, fixing, and adding error handling for product display issues on the deployed home page in Version 12.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files including components, pages, hooks, utilities, and configuration files for the Swapan Store e-commerce application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining OKLCH color system for light and dark modes, including background, foreground, primary, secondary, accent, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Swapan Store application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component using TanStack Router to define routes for products, cart, checkout, admin dashboard, and admin login pages, with ErrorBoundary wrappers and layout components including Header and Footer.
Dialog modal component with form for creating new products, including validation for name, description, price, category selection, and image URL fields with loading states and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/EditProductModal: Dialog modal component for editing existing products with pre-populated form fields, validation, and update functionality using the useUpdateProduct hook with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary component that catches and displays errors with a fallback UI, showing error details in a collapsible section and providing a reload button.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright information and a "Built with caffeine.ai" attribution link with a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header component with logo, search bar, navigation links (Products/Admin), and a cart button with item count badge.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying product image, name, description, price, category badge, and quantity selector with add-to-cart functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous actor instance based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Custom hook managing admin authentication state using sessionStorage with login/logout functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching products and cart contents, plus mutations for cart operations (add/remove) and product price updates with validation and error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, earthy Indian spice market color palette for both light and dark modes, including colors for backgrounds, borders, buttons, and charts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page for managing products and viewing orders, with features for editing product prices, adding/editing products via modals, authentication checks, and displaying sorted order history.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Admin login page with password verification form that uses the admin authentication hook to verify credentials and navigate to the admin dashboard upon successful login.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Shopping cart page displaying cart items with local image mapping, quantity display, total price calculation, and functionality to remove items or proceed to checkout.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page with order summary, phone number and address input forms, validation logic, and order placement functionality that navigates to products page on success.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Main products listing page with category filtering, search functionality, local image mapping for products, and extensive debug logging for troubleshooting product data flow.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrice.ts: Utility function that formats numeric price values to Indian Rupee format with ₹ symbol prefix and two decimal places.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, Inter/Poppins fonts, custom shadows, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking for Swapan Store e-commerce app (version 27) with known issues about products not displaying on deployed pages, and existing features including product listings, shopping cart, admin dashboard, and Indian Rupee pricing.
